goal: Build Curve Battle / Tron Lightcycles 1v1 mobile P2P WebRTC browser game with gap generation, touch controls, and solo AI mode

steps.name: Game Physics & Curve Trail Engine
steps.description: Implement 60FPS 2D curve movement, periodic gap/hole generation, line collision math, particle explosion, and synth audio in js/game.js

steps.name: WebRTC P2P Multiplayer & Solo AI
steps.description: Implement PeerJS room signaling, WhatsApp link sharing (?room=XYZ), input synchronization, and intelligent solo practice bot in js/network.js

steps.name: Cyberpunk UI & Mobile Touch Controls
steps.description: Build responsive index.html with side-by-side touch steering zones, score board, neon glow CRT styling in css/style.css

steps.name: GitHub Repo Creation & Pages Deployment
steps.description: Create GitHub repo Valentino-source-dev/curve-battle, commit all files, push, and enable GitHub Pages
